# actions-warden

> Audit GitHub Actions in one repository or across a GitHub organization, then
> pin, verify, and upgrade dependencies with explicit write authorization.

Requires Node.js 20+. The CLI is non-interactive. `pin` and `upgrade` are
dry-run by default. Normal JSON payloads use `schemaVersion: "1.0"`. Exit code
1 is a completed `FAIL` result to inspect; exit code 2 is an invocation error.
Organization scans support guarded `--checkpoint` / `--resume` state and
stderr-only live progress while retaining fresh repository tree validation.
For agent-initiated organization scans, pass `--agent-mode` or set
`ACTIONS_WARDEN_MODE=agent`. It defaults to scope-keyed JSON report and
checkpoint files, compatible resume, no progress, and a bounded stdout receipt.
Preserve requested scope; do not load the complete report into model context.
